items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Frank Schiffman of the Apollo heard about the band over there. He came over to listen to us. So, he liked us, and he booked us into the Harlem Opera House.

ctx.x: How did the band get to New York?

Oh, the school bus. We went up during a tour of one-night stands up to Asbury Park. And, from Asbury Park, we went into Elizabeth, New Jersey. That was supposed to be the last date, and then turn around and go back to the school.

Frank Schiffman of the Apollo heard about the band over there. He came over to listen to us. So, he liked us, and he booked us into the Harlem Opera House. And, that's how we happened to get into New York. We went into the Harlem Opera House.
